Container.Name: enshrouded-server
Container.Overview:
A dedicated server for Enshrouded. The server is a Windows program. The latest tag runs it with Wine. To use Proton GE, change the tag to proton.
Requirements: 2 to 4 CPU cores at 3.2 GHz, 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended), 20 GB SSD storage.
Forward UDP port 15637 on your router. If you change the port, also change QUERY_PORT.
Set GENERATE_SETTINGS to false if you edit enshrouded_server.json by hand. Otherwise the container writes over your changes on each start.
Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: UDP query port. Forward it on your router. Must be the same as QUERY_PORT.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Optional password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players at the same time.

Config.Name: Query Port Variable
Config.Description: UDP query port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Query Port.

Config.Name: Generate Settings
Config.Description: Write the settings from this template to enshrouded_server.json on each start. Set to false to use the file on disk as it is.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Download and validate the server files on each start. Set to false to skip.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as.
